messages:
jess: Hey team — customer (acme_oncall) reporting 422 on function/tool call flow. They say model returned a tool call but our schema validator rejects the args due to enum casing. request_id: r-8a1f23c4. Blocking production.

mike: Can you paste the minimal request/response and the exact error body? 422 usually means the payload parsed but failed JSON schema validation.

jess: Minimal repro from customer below. They call our hosted endpoint with an OpenAI-style function call.
```
POST /v1/generate
{
  "model": "gpt-4o-mini",
  "messages": [{"role":"user","content":"Promote artifact 123"}],
  "functions": [{
    "name": "repo_action",
    "parameters": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "action": {"type": "string", "enum": ["PROMOTE", "DEPRECATE"]}
      },
      "required": ["action"]
    }
  }],
  "function_call": {"name": "repo_action"}
}
```
Response body from model (returned to us):
```json
{"name":"repo_action","arguments":"{\"action\":\"promote\"}"}
```
Customer then sees our API return: `422 Unprocessable Entity` with message: `invalid enum value "promote" for property action`

linh: That matches a common drift: model emits lowercase alias `promote` while our validator expects uppercase `PROMOTE`. Our compatibility normalizer currently maps enum aliases for top-level tool selection, but I think it doesn't recurse into the JSON string inside `arguments` after we parse it.

mike: Where in the pipeline do we parse the `arguments` string? We decode it into JSON and then run x-schema validator right? If we never run the enum normalizer on that object, we'll hit this. Can you attach broker logs for r-8a1f23c4? Also include model name/version & temperature.

jess: Attached logs (snip):
```\
[deploy-broker] 2153456789 r-8a1f23c4 model=gpt-4o-mini temp=0.7 returned tool_call name=repo_action arguments="{\"action\":\"promote\"}"
[validator] parsed arguments -> {action: "promote"} -> schema validation failed enum check
```

support-bot: Created ticket #SUP-12345 and linked to this thread.

mike: Quick mitigation idea: add a case-insensitive enum matcher in the validator for function args and known enumerated fields, until we implement a full normalizer. But this is a behavioral change; we should gate it behind a compatibility toggle.

rao: Escalate to eng-ml for guidance on whether we should accept aliasing by default. Accepting aliases is more forgiving but could mask legitimate invalid values. Also need to verify other fields (numbers-as-strings, booleans) inside `arguments` where the model sometimes stringifies values.

linh: Proposal: 1) tolerate enum aliases (case-insensitive match) when `arguments` was produced by a model response envelope (function/tool call), 2) add tests covering both `PROMOTE` and `promote`, and 3) add opt-in strict validation for enterprise customers who require exact enums. This minimizes disruptions.

mike: Sounds reasonable. I'll draft a small fix: after we parse `arguments` (JSON.parse) run the existing enum alias normalizer over that object before schema validate. I'll add feature-flag guard and add a unit test and an integration repro using the customer's payload.

jess: Customer is in us-west-2, latency ~120ms. They need a short ETA — marking P2. I've told them we're investigating and asked for the raw model response headers and the full request id.

mike: PR/branch: feat/compat/normalize-fn-args — will link when ready. Noted to include regression harness that simulates both `function_call` and `tool_call` envelopes (the latter when models return `arguments` as string).

linh: Also check for nested enums and arrays of enums inside `arguments` — traversal needs to be recursive.

jess: Customer confirmed they can test a quick patch on their side if we provide a suggested temporary workaround (transform action to uppercase before sending to our API). They're happy to try.

mike: I'll post a temporary snippet they can run client-side: `parsed = JSON.parse(arguments); if (parsed.action) parsed.action = parsed.action.toUpperCase();` but note this only for `action`. We'll push platform fix ASAP.

jess: Thanks. I'll keep the customer posted and update ticket #SUP-12345 when PR is merged. :thumbsup:

mike: Adding owners: @linh (compat), @rao (policy), @mike (validator). Assign to eng-ml for final spec decision.

jess: Closing loop for now — escalation tracked. Will re-open if customer still sees failures after the fix.
